info.name: ZipBasket Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for ZipBasket — a multi-vendor grocery delivery platform.

**Services:** API Gateway (3000) → Auth (3001) · User (3002) · Product (3003) · Order (3004) · Vendor (3005) · Delivery (3006) · Payment (3007) · Notification (3008) · Admin (3009) · Socket (3010)

**Usage:**
1. Set `baseUrl` collection variable to `http://localhost:3000`
2. Run any Auth request and copy the `accessToken` from the response
3. Set `authToken` collection variable to that token
4. All protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Phone OTP, Email/password, Google and Apple Sign-In. All routes are public (no JWT required). Rate-limited to 10 req/15 min per IP.

request.description: Send a 6-digit OTP to the given phone number via FastToSms. OTP expires in 5 minutes.
Verify OTP and receive access + refresh JWT tokens. `role` must be one of: `customer`, `vendor`, `rider`.
Register a new account with email + password. Password must be ≥8 chars, contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and symbol.
Exchange a Google ID token (from Google Sign-In on the mobile app) for a ZipBasket JWT pair.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token. Refresh tokens are valid for 30 days.
Invalidate the refresh token server-side (stored in Redis). Access token will expire naturally after 15 minutes.

item.name: 👤 User
item.description: Customer, vendor, and rider profile management. All routes require a valid JWT.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile (Customer, Vendor, or Rider model depending on JWT role).
List all saved delivery addresses for the authenticated customer.

item.name: 🛒 Products
item.description: Product catalogue, categories, and admin pricing. GET routes are public; write routes require ADMIN JWT.

query.description: hi | en — returns nameHi when lang=hi

request.description: Returns today's available products. Results are cached in Redis (1 hr TTL). Use `?lang=hi` to get Hindi product names (`nameHi`).
Returns products that have not been priced today (lastPricedAt < today). Used by admin dashboard.
Toggles `isAvailableToday`. The carry-forward model means whatever is set persists until admin explicitly changes it again.

item.name: 📦 Orders
item.description: Full order lifecycle — stock check, placement, vendor routing, ratings. Customer routes require CUSTOMER role; vendor routes require VENDOR role.

request.description: Pre-payment stock check. Geo-queries vendors within 5km radius. Returns `serviceable: true/false`. Only show payment options if serviceable.
Preview coupon discount without side effects. Shows `discountAmount` but does NOT mark coupon as used.
Place an order. For `cod`: vendor routing starts immediately. For `upi`: routing starts after payment confirmation. Price is snapshotted at order time.
Accessible by customer (own orders), vendor (assigned sub-orders), and rider (assigned deliveries).
Cancel an order. Only allowed if no sub-order has been picked up yet.
Rate product (1–5) and rider (1–5) after delivery. Rider rating average is updated atomically using aggregation pipeline. Can only rate once per order.
Returns orders currently in the routing offer window for this vendor.
Vendor accepts with specific items (may be partial). If all items across vendors are covered, sub-orders are built and rider assignment starts.
Vendor rejects the order. Routing engine cascades to the next batch of vendors.

item.name: 🏪 Vendor
item.description: Vendor inventory management and earnings. Requires VENDOR or ADMIN JWT.

request.description: Create or update stock for a product. Uses upsert — safe to call on new or existing inventory items.

item.name: 🛵 Delivery
item.description: Rider availability, job management, and live location. All routes require RIDER JWT.

request.description: Toggle rider online/offline. Riders must be online to receive delivery job requests.
Returns current active job and pending offered jobs for the rider.
Accept a delivery job within the 30-second offer window. First rider to accept gets the job; others are automatically declined.
Rider marks items as picked up from vendor. Order sub-status transitions to `picked`. Customer receives push notification.
Rider marks order as delivered. Rider earnings are incremented (80% of delivery fee). If all sub-orders delivered, parent order becomes `delivered`.
Called by rider app every 5 seconds. Upserts RiderLocation + Rider.currentLocation and broadcasts `rider:location` event to customer via Socket Server.
Returns today / thisWeek / total earnings for the authenticated rider.

item.name: 💳 Payments
item.description: PhonePe UPI, COD, refunds, and vendor payouts. PhonePe callback is public (server-to-server); all others require auth.

request.description: Initiates a PhonePe UPI payment. Amount is in paise (₹360 = 36000). Returns a `paymentUrl` to redirect the customer to PhonePe's payment page.
⚠️ This endpoint is called by PhonePe servers, not by the mobile app. Verifies X-Verify checksum, decodes payload, and on PAYMENT_SUCCESS triggers vendor routing.
Poll PhonePe API for payment status. Use this if the callback was not received or to confirm status before showing order confirmation screen.
Admin-triggered refund via PhonePe Refund API. Amount in paise.
Marks all pending VendorEarning records for this vendor as `paid`. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times.

item.name: 🔔 Notifications
item.description: FCM token management and admin bulk push notifications.

request.description: Called by mobile apps on startup to register/refresh the FCM device token. Updates the token on the user's Customer, Vendor, or Rider document.
Admin-triggered bulk push to ALL customers. Sent in chunks of 500 tokens using FCM multicast. Requires ADMIN role.

item.name: ⚙️ Admin
item.description: Admin dashboard, analytics, vendor/rider/customer management, order overrides, payouts, and coupons. All routes require ADMIN JWT.

request.description: Returns live metrics: ordersToday, revenueToday, totalRevenue, pendingOrders, activeRiders, onlineRiders, activeVendors, totalCustomers, newCustomersToday. All queries run in parallel.
Revenue timeline, top products, top vendors, orders-by-status, and payment method breakdown.
Shows stale products (not priced today), unavailable products, and per-category summary.
Aggregated payout summary grouped by vendor: total pending amount, total paid amount, earning count.
Marks all pending VendorEarning records for this vendor as `paid`. Idempotent.
Create a new coupon. `discountType: flat` deducts a fixed amount; `percent` deducts a percentage (capped at `maxDiscountAmount`).
Sets `isActive: false` on the coupon (soft delete — coupon remains in DB for audit).

item.name: 🏥 Health Checks
item.description: Health endpoints for all services. No auth required. Useful for monitoring and Docker health checks.
